scale.sizeBasis: Brightness converted to a reference-sphere size; not resolved dimensions or measured volume.
scale.uncertaintyInterpretation: Author sensitivity estimate approximately -15/+30 percent for assumed albedo ±0.02 and H ±0.1 mag; not a measured Gaussian 1-sigma interval. Published rounded diameter/radius need not be exact doubles.
scale.referenceRadiusUse: Adopt the body-page nominal radius, as Kiviuq does, and use it as equal-volume display scale only. Do not recompute it from rounded H or silently substitute the older 122-body table diameter.

displayOrientation.phaseEpoch: display reference only; no measured W0 or landmark epoch
displayOrientation.spinSense: Not propagated; physical spin sense unknown
displayOrientation.displayPeriodUse: The reported rotation period is an informational fact. The prepared scene uses a fixed arbitrary display phase and does not propagate physical spin
displayOrientation.qualification: Physical pole, spin sense and current rotational phase remain unmeasured. The displayed motion does not fit the Cassini lightcurve.

shapeLimit: Low elongation floor; multiple extrema mean it is not an actual recovered surface.
sourceDiscrepancies: Older 122-target overview nominal diameter 14 km differs from current Table 1C rounding/inputs. Adopt this row's body-page radius 7.3 km and retain quoted diameter range; do not mix them as precise measurements.
